title: Language as a Tonal Medium — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Language as a Tonal Medium's rich face: the five Semantic Webcam builds gathered beside the step of the argument each one proves, a note that fronts the camera, and the fingerprint of the words they were laid against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.

sections.heading: The evidence — five iterations of one instrument

pieces.file: Language as a Tonal Medium — rich — camera.md
pieces.near: The claim is not an argument

pieces.title: Live STIGMERGY Cam · iteration 1
pieces.caption: **Tone only.** Your camera as an amber terminal grid: brightness picks a glyph from a density ramp, and the picture holds. Cycle the glyph sets (**g**) — blocks, CP437, ASCII, braille — and none of them ever reads. The meaning channel, absent.

pieces.title: Word Flock Cam · iteration 2
pieces.caption: **Meaning, unmoored.** Words flock to whatever moves and whatever is dark — a guess at your eyes and fingertips — and they say something as they go. But they ride on top of the picture instead of drawing it; the dim grid underneath still does all the shading. The failure that shows the two channels have to be joined on purpose.

pieces.title: Character Multiply Cam · iteration 3, the anchor
pieces.caption: **The anchor.** Brightness picks the glyph — period, dash, a letter of a whole word, shade, then a white tile with a black letter punched into it — and whole words typeset themselves into each run of mid-tone. A region is the right darkness and a readable word at once. Press **g** to swap words for blocks: the same picture, with the reading taken out.

pieces.title: Grammar-Fit Cam · iteration 4
pieces.caption: **The strong test.** Each blob becomes a composed line: a word-to-word chain learned from the source text walks along it, choosing what could plausibly follow and still fits the width. **w** steps flow → fill → grammar. Read a blob aloud in each and judge for yourself whether sense survives.

pieces.title: Tonal-Word Cam · iteration 5
pieces.caption: **Light picks the word.** The words hold steady under the smoothing the anchor brought in (the *smooth* slider). What this build adds: brightness now chooses *which word*, scoring each grammar-legal candidate by its ink against the blob's brightness. Sweep **b**, tone-bias, from 0, where grammar alone picks, to 1, where ink picks among the words grammar allows — the open question below, free rider or separate budget, as a slider.
